detail.longDescription:
I'm attempting to write the RBG values of the position of my current mouse cursor to a paragraph tag within my HTML section. This is my current code: const c = document.getElementById("b"); const ctx = c.getContext("2d"); ctx.fillStyle = "pink"; ctx.fillRect(25, 25, 100, 100); c.addEventListener("mousemove", check); function check(event) { let x = event.clientX; let y = event.clientY; document.getElementById("t").innerHTML = "x:"+x+"y:"+y; document.getElementById("t2").innerHTML = ctx.getImageData(x,y,1,1).data; }

t and t2 are valid paragraph tags, and the x and y values are written to t perfectly fine. However, when I hover over the pink square, the values shown in t2 do not change, still remaining as 0,0,0,0 . What am I doing wrong?
